changelog:
VIUMO v1.1.4 • Maintenance & Reliability Update 🛠️

We've listened, investigated, fixed, and tested. This update focuses on resolving the issues reported by the Viumo community and making the overall experience more reliable.

What's Fixed:
• Fixed an issue that could cause the Movie Details screen to crash for some users.
• Fixed Continue Watching and resume behavior, including the Next Episode flow after resuming an episode.
• Improved Continue Watching titles and navigation so it's easier to identify exactly where you left off.
• Addressed reported playback and navigation issues discovered during testing.

A special thank you to the Viumo user who submitted a detailed report, reproduction steps, and thoughtful suggestions.❤️

Your suggestion for a better language-selection experience has also been heard and will be considered as a future improvement.

Thank you for helping us make Viumo better. 🚀
